faqs.title: General
faqs.question: Where is DUDE MENS WEAR located?
faqs.answer: We are located in Tharamangalam, Salem District, Tamil Nadu. We have been serving customers since 2020.

faqs.title: General
faqs.question: Can I order online?
faqs.answer: Yes! We provide convenient online ordering through our website, allowing you to shop from anywhere.

faqs.title: Returns & Refunds
faqs.question: How long do I have to return an item?
faqs.answer: You must make a refund/return request within 3 days from the date of delivery. The item must be unused and in its original packaging with all accompanying documents.

faqs.title: Returns & Refunds
faqs.question: What conditions make an item eligible for return?
faqs.answer: We offer returns if the item is defective or damaged upon arrival, the wrong item was delivered, or the item does not match the description or images on our website.

faqs.title: Returns & Refunds
faqs.question: Are all items refundable?
faqs.answer: No, we do not offer refunds for items purchased during sale, clearance, or promotional offers.

faqs.title: Returns & Refunds
faqs.question: How do I request a refund?
faqs.answer: Contact our customer support team via WhatsApp at 9488924935. Provide your order number, images of the item (if damaged/defective), and a brief explanation.

faqs.title: Returns & Refunds
faqs.question: How long does it take to receive my refund?
faqs.answer: After inspection and approval, refunds are credited to your original payment method within 3-4 business days. For replacements, the new product will be delivered within 5-7 days.

faqs.title: Shipping
faqs.question: How long does shipping take?
faqs.answer: Orders are delivered within 2-5 days from the date of order and payment, subject to courier company norms.

faqs.title: Shipping
faqs.question: How will I know when my order is shipped?
faqs.answer: Delivery confirmation will be sent to your WhatsApp number provided in the delivery address.

faqs.title: Shipping
faqs.question: Can I change my shipping address after placing an order?
faqs.answer: Please contact us immediately at 9488924935 via WhatsApp if you need to change your shipping address. We'll do our best to accommodate if the order hasn't been shipped yet.

faqs.title: Sizing & Fit
faqs.question: How do I know if the "Slim Fit" shirts will fit me?
faqs.answer: Our Slim Fit cuts are designed to be closer to the body through the chest and waist. If you prefer a more relaxed feel or are between sizes, we recommend sizing up. You can find specific measurements in the "Size Guide" link on every product page.

cms_pages.title: About DUDE MENS WEAR
cms_pages.content:
About Us

DUDE MENS WEAR - Established in 2020, DUDE MENS WEAR is a trusted retail clothing brand located in Tharamangalam, Salem District. We are committed to providing high-quality men's clothing at the best prices.

Our store is known for its reliability, affordability, and customer satisfaction. We offer a wide range of stylish and comfortable outfits to suit every occasion.

To make shopping more convenient, we also provide online ordering through our website, allowing customers to shop easily from anywhere.

At DUDE MENS WEAR, quality meets affordability.

cms_pages.title: Frequently Asked Questions
cms_pages.content:
# Frequently Asked Questions

## Ordering & Payment

**Q: What payment methods do you accept?**
We accept all major payment methods:
- UPI (GPay, PhonePe, Paytm)
- Credit/Debit Cards
- Net Banking
- Cash on Delivery (COD)

**Q: Is Cash on Delivery available?**
Yes! COD is available for orders across India.

**Q: How do I use a coupon code?**
Enter your code in the "Apply Coupon" field on the checkout page before payment.

---

## Shipping & Delivery

**Q: How long does delivery take?**
- Tamil Nadu: 2-4 business days
- Rest of India: 4-7 business days

**Q: Do you offer free shipping?**
Yes! Free shipping on all orders above ₹499.

**Q: Can I track my order?**
Absolutely! You'll receive a tracking link via SMS and email once your order is shipped.

---

## Returns & Refunds

**Q: What is your return policy?**
7-day no questions asked returns. Contact us within 7 days of delivery.

**Q: How do I initiate a return?**
Simply message us on WhatsApp or email. We'll arrange a pickup.

**Q: When will I get my refund?**
5-7 business days after we receive the returned item.

---

## Product & Sizing

**Q: How do I choose the right size?**
Check our Size Guide on each product page. Still confused? Send us a WhatsApp message with your measurements!

**Q: Are your products original?**
Yes! All products are designed and sourced by us. No fakes, no replicas.

---

## Still Have Questions?
WhatsApp: [Chat Now](https://wa.me/919876543210)
Email: support@dudemw.com

cms_pages.title: Refund and Return Policy
cms_pages.content:
Refund and Return Policy

At DUDE MENS WEAR, we prioritize customer satisfaction and strive to provide high-quality products. If you are not completely satisfied with your purchase, our refund policy outlines the conditions under which refunds are applicable.

1. Eligibility for Refunds / Returns

We offer refunds / Returns under the following conditions:

  • The item is defective or damaged upon arrival.
  • The wrong item was delivered.
  • The item does not match the description or images provided on our website.

To be eligible for a refund / Returns:

  • The item must be unused, and in its original packaging with all accompanying documents (e.g., invoice, shipping label etc.)
  • A refund / Return request must be made within 3 days from the date of delivery.

2. Non-Refundable Items

We do not offer refunds for:

  • Items purchased during sale, clearance, or promotional offers.

3. Refund Process

To request a refund:

  • Contact our customer support team via WhatsApp at 9488924935
  • Provide your order number, images of the item (if damaged/defective), and a brief explanation.

If any damaged / defective / replacement products are approved, then it will be done and delivered within 5-7 days.

After inspection, if any refunds are approved, we will initiate the refund and it will be credited to your original payment method within 3-4 business days.

4. Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received a refund within the stated period, first check with your bank or payment provider.

If the issue persists, contact us at 9488924935

cms_pages.title: Shipping Policy
cms_pages.content:
Shipping Policy

The orders for the user are shipped through registered domestic courier companies and/or speed post only.

Delivery Timeline

Orders will be delivered within 2-5 days from the date of the order and/or payment or as per the delivery date agreed at the time of order confirmation and delivering of the shipment, subject to courier company / post office norms.

Important Information

  • Platform Owner shall not be liable for any delay in delivery by the courier company / postal authority.
  • Delivery of all orders will be made to the address provided by the buyer at the time of purchase.
  • Delivery of our services will be confirmed on your WhatsApp number given in delivery address.
  • If there are any shipping cost(s) levied by the seller or the Platform Owner (as the case be), the same is not refundable.
